packageRules.description: FOP updates change renderer behavior and need the compatibility probes.
prBodyNotes: Run `./verification/gradlew -p verification test -PfopVersion={{newValue}} --tests '*FopGapTest'` against the candidate release, update the XSD compatibility annotations, and regenerate the compatibility report before merging.

packageRules.description: Gradle wrapper updates also change the wrapper JAR and the distribution checksum.
prBodyNotes: Run `./verification/gradlew -p verification wrapper --no-daemon`, commit the regenerated wrapper files, and verify the distribution SHA-256 before merging.

packageRules.description: Keep verification on the Java 21 toolchain.
